statement: For a residual block T(C,x)=A(C,x)+g(f(A(C,x);theta_f);theta_g), a perfect implicit update exists if f is input-controllable, g is output-controllable, and the relevant activations are nonzero.

quantifiers.input_controllability: for every nonzero z and z+delta_z
quantifiers.output_controllability: for every fixed nonzero v and every desired delta_y
quantifiers.conclusion: there exist parameter updates producing exact block-output equality

assumptions: the block has the stated residual decomposition
all denominators named by the construction are nonzero
verdict_rule: VERIFIED only if all actual Transformers-class routes satisfy the equality, topology and assumption gates and every negative control separates; otherwise FALSIFIED if a valid counterexample satisfies all assumptions, else BLOCKED.
